name: Dino Land
description: Ten prehistoric and dinosaur-themed maps normalized to the shared project map catalog layout.

maps.name: Stone Camp Meadow
maps.theme: A gentle prehistoric meadow built around a cave camp with huts, fire pits, watering pools, and roaming hunter-gatherers. Introductory and spacious.

maps.name: Mammoth Tundra
maps.theme: A snowy tundra packed with woolly mammoths, woolly rhinoceroses, ice pools, and mammoth-bone shelters. Teaches movement around broad open terrain.

maps.name: Fernswamp Raptor Run
maps.theme: A humid fern swamp crawling with raptors, egg nests, reeds, and shallow pools. Narrow channels and vegetation create more tactical movement.

maps.name: Sabertooth Canyon
maps.theme: A warm canyon arena full of rock mesas, cave mouths, bones, and prowling sabre-tooth cats. Sightlines are long but routes loop around obstacles.

maps.name: Cave Village Crossing
maps.theme: A lively settlement with huts, fenced enclosures, smoke pits, drying racks, and bustling cave men and cave women. Central routes intersect constantly.

maps.name: Glacial Mammoth Pass
maps.theme: A dangerous glacial corridor full of cliffs, crevasses, ice bridges, mammoths, and woolly rhinos. Precision pathing matters here.

maps.name: Dino Jungle Basin
maps.theme: A dense primeval basin with towering dinosaurs, heavy jungle growth, nests, and tangled routes. Big creatures create moving obstacles everywhere.

maps.name: Tar Pit Timewarp
maps.theme: A brutal tar field where eras collide: fossils, sabre-tooths, mammoths, and dinosaurs stalk the same muddy arena. Movement is constantly punished.

maps.name: Chrono Rift Highlands
maps.theme: Jagged highlands fractured by glowing time rifts that pull together creatures from different eras. Constant spatial pressure and mixed hazards.

maps.name: Primeval Citadel
maps.theme: The final arena: a circular citadel combining volcanic, icy, jungle, and village biomes. Cave people, mammoths, rhinos, sabre-tooths, and dinosaurs all collide here.
